title: Phase A 1/8: generator and templates for lead, section blocks and stream; section findings lists; /wire/ redirect
description:
Phase A, step 1. Generator and templates for the new anatomy (design note on the epic). No hook or CSS change here; the generated pages render with the old hook until step 2 lands, so merge steps 1-3 together or in order within one release. Files: 1. web/pages/reference-list.template.md: replace with this layout (the @@if / @TOKEN@ syntax is the one tools/sync_section_pages.py already processes): ``` ::band{size="bare"} ::raw
::endraw ::include{kind="block" name="page-top" title="@TITLE@" lead="@LEAD@"} ::raw @@if groups
@@end ::endraw @@if groups ::include{kind="references" select="recent" bucket="week"@MEDIUM@ count="@SOURCE_COUNT@"} ::raw
::endraw @@end ::raw
::endraw ::include{kind="references" select="recent" bucket="week"@MEDIUM@@SECTION@ count="@PAGE_COUNT@" paged="true" id="@LIST_ID@" empty="@EMPTY@"} ::raw
::endraw ``` The `recommended` block and its tokens are removed (the pending panels move to /just-found/, separate task). 2. tools/sync_section_pages.py: - Constants: `LEAD_CARDS = 4` (a feature then a row of three), `STREAM_FIRST_PAGE_CARDS = 60` (whole rows at 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 columns), `PAGE_COUNT = LEAD_CARDS + STREAM_FIRST_PAGE_CARDS`, `GROUP_SOURCE_COUNT = 500` with the comment "Phase A only: how far down the order the section blocks look; replaced by the engine's groups (Papyrus PPY-2d9715). A section whose best Reference ranks lower gets no block on /videos/ but stays reachable at its own list." `FINDINGS_PAGE_ID_PREFIX = "sectionfindings-"`, `FINDINGS_FETCHED_PAST_VIDEOS = 24` (Phase A only: the section front's findings include mixes videos in and the hook drops them; replaced by notMedium, Papyrus PPY-a9402d). - REFERENCE_LIST_PAGES values: videos.md: CLASSES "mom-videos ", TITLE "Videos", LEAD "Videos we think are worth watching.", KIND "videos", NOUN "videos", MEDIUM ' medium="video"', SECTION "", EMPTY "No videos have been accepted yet.", LIST_ID "untagged", groups True. findings.md: CLASSES "", TITLE "Findings", LEAD "Every source our editors and Cyclotron have accepted. Each card says who accepted it.", KIND "findings", NOUN "findings", MEDIUM "", SECTION "", EMPTY "Nothing has been accepted yet.", LIST_ID "untagged", groups True. Keep LIST_ID "untagged" so the live chunk files (reference-lists/videos/untagged/, reference-lists/findings/untagged/) are reused. - Every page also gets LEAD_CARDS, PAGE_COUNT, SOURCE_COUNT filled from the constants. Drop the `plain` and `recommended` handling and the RECOMMENDED_* / SLUG tokens. - `section_videos_values(section)`: TITLE "
